scientific_evidence_role: implementation audit only; no lifecycle or numerical result

evidence: MIRIX mirix.embeddings.embedding_model constructs OpenAIEmbedding without forwarding config.embedding_model
the original wrapper checks a separate 1536-dimensional endpoint but does not bind MIRIX's internal agent states to it
findings.risk: The lifecycle can contact a prohibited external endpoint, use a different embedding model identity, or fail for the wrong reason while the health check still passes.

evidence: eval_framework/memory_adapters/qwen_embed_adapter.py sends remote image bytes only when QWEN_VL_EMBED_REMOTE_IMAGES=1
the source default is 0 and the original wrapper does not set the variable
the lifecycle image-reference invariant can be satisfied by retained image metadata even if the embedding request encoded the file path as text
findings.risk: A false multimodal lifecycle acceptance is possible without any pixel-level image embedding.

successor_requirements: route MIRIX's pre-construction embedding config and client factory to the exact local 1536-dimensional endpoint and model name
set and validate QWEN_VL_EMBED_REMOTE_IMAGES=1 before adapter construction
capture per-lifecycle chat and embedding service-log deltas
reject any observed HTTP 4xx/5xx, OOM, traceback, A-Mem metadata-extraction error, or Omni-SimpleMem add failure
retain the frozen source checkout unmodified and record the runtime guard hash
prohibited: treating this audit as evidence that either corrected lifecycle passes
starting Wave2 services while Wave1 is active
